shots.action: Macro: a single chili pepper reignites from grey ash, embers crawling across its skin in the dark.
Slow dolly through a torch-lit Maya jungle temple, carved glyphs glowing ember-orange.
Slow macro push-in: thick lava-red hot sauce pours over grilled corn on a stone altar, steam rising.
The Sauce Empire bottle stands on the altar, flame-orange rim light, torch flames behind it.
